svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide: 3 mm plate 220 wide x 100 tall with a 20 mm knob.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guides: two strips 280 long built from 6 x 6 bar and a 3 mm lip,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded to the front of the shell above and below the air inlet,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the slide moves sideways between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top guide: underside 148 above the bottom of the shell;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom guide: top 48 above. Air inlet 160 x 60 between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The slide is a loose fit (about 1 mm): it must move by hand when hot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide fully across to shut the air; open it to burn faster.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the slide covers the inlet when shut and moves freely;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top guide clears the door plate by at least 3 mm.
